g.text: Box Office: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ to Lead With $30 Million Opening Weekend, ‘Cat in the Hat’ Aims for $20 Million Debut ◆ ‘Club Kid,’ ‘Queen at Sea’ Earn Top Prizes at Philadelphia Film Festival; 35th Edition Sets All-Time Attendance Record (EXCLUSIVE) ◆ Maya Hawke to Star in ‘Magic: The Gathering’ Movie ◆ Inde Navarrette’s ‘SNL’ Episode Hits Season High of 5.2 Million Viewers ◆ Tony Awards Will Remain on CBS Through 2032 Under New Five-Year Deal ◆ Variety’s 10 Comics to Watch for 2026 ◆
